activity_summary: At supper you paid threepence for the fish. You said the stage had been cold, the flag was up on the other bank, and you had not crossed. You did not bring the morning's reading to the board again, and you did not say a total.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Paid threepence, refused a second reading, and said he had not crossed.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Set the fish and the price, and told him not to improve it.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Counted the trenchers, and kept the threepence.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The flag was up on the other bank. I did not cross.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: This is supper. Sit, eat, and do not improve the fish into a moral.
